name: Meritor EX+ Air Disc Brake Service Reference
usage_note: Curated OEM-level retrieval notes for Meritor EX+ air disc brake service context. Confirm exact caliper/brake model and vehicle application before parts selection or repair. Brake work is safety-critical; use current Meritor maintenance procedures, specifications and inspection limits.

documents.title: Meritor EX+ air disc brake service scope
documents.summary: Meritor identifies EX+ as an air disc brake family with dedicated maintenance information, including Maintenance Manual MM0467. Parts Xpress associates EX+ service calipers and pad kits with model/application-specific hardware. Diagnose and service by exact brake model and application rather than assuming all air disc brake parts interchange.

documents.title: Meritor EX+ wheels-on inspection context
documents.summary: Meritor Parts Xpress references SP18116 as an EX+ wheels-on inspection publication. For an EX+ complaint, establish pad condition/wear, rotor condition, caliper condition/movement and visible hardware issues before deciding on replacement. Apply current Meritor wear limits and procedures from the model-specific publication rather than generic measurements.

documents.title: Meritor EX+ caliper identification before repair
documents.summary: EX+ parts listings show distinct caliper variants such as EX225H and EX225L and application-specific mounting details. Capture the complete caliper/model/application information, chamber configuration and mounting arrangement before selecting a caliper or hardware kit. Similar-looking EX+ assemblies should not be treated as automatically interchangeable.

documents.title: Meritor EX+ pad and hardware service
documents.summary: Meritor EX+ service kits can include application-specific friction pads plus springs, retainers and other hardware. Pad replacement decisions should include inspection of associated hardware and caliper/rotor condition, not just friction thickness. Match the pad kit to the exact EX+ brake configuration and current Meritor catalog/service information.

documents.title: Panta rule for Meritor EX+ brake complaints
documents.summary: For EX+ complaints such as drag, uneven wear, overheating, pull or rapid pad wear, identify the exact brake model and inspect the system rather than automatically replacing the caliper. Consider pad/hardware condition, rotor condition, caliper movement, chamber/application configuration and upstream air-brake causes. Use current Meritor MM0467/model-specific procedures for final diagnosis, measurements and torque specifications.
